name.ja: 線形Maxwell電磁場（真空・誘電体）
name.en: Linear Maxwell fields in vacuum and dielectrics

note.ja: 代表式は3D線形電磁場です。今回の実装はz不変の円柱Ez/Hx/Hyに制限した真2D Yee計算です。
note.en: The representative equations describe three-dimensional linear electromagnetics. This implementation is restricted to a z-invariant, genuinely two-dimensional Yee cylinder problem with Ez/Hx/Hy.

note.ja: 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
note.en: A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.

name.en: Mie scattering width of a two-dimensional dielectric cylinder

caption.ja: 保存した最細格子の実2D散乱電場phasorの実部。 図の中央の白抜きは診断用のr<0.4のマスクで、物理円柱の半径0.25とは区別します。
caption.en: Real part of the actual saved scattered electric phasor on the finest two-dimensional grid. The central white region is a diagnostic mask at r<0.4, distinct from the physical cylinder radius0.25.

note.ja: Yeeの散乱場を局所分極contrastの厳密な離散入射差分で励起します。EとHはそれぞれの整数・半時刻でFourier集計し、Hの4点補間後に物理流束を積分します。
note.en: Advance the scattered Yee fields with an exact discrete incident difference on the polarization-contrast support. Accumulate E and H at their own integer and half times, then integrate physical power after four-point native-face collocation.

name.en: Oblique s/p incidence on a Lorentz-dispersive slab

caption.ja: 保存したp偏光の実電場をky=4の周期y方向へ再構成した場。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved p-polarized electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction at ky=4. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

note.ja: 単一ky Yee空間演算と局所の陰的中点Lorentz ADE。p偏光の両電場に分極を結合し、同格子の真空波束で入射・伝播位相を除きます。直接Ohmic・物質減衰仕事と修正エネルギーを別々に集計します。
note.en: Use the single-ky Yee spatial operator and local implicit-midpoint Lorentz ADE. Couple both p-polarized electric components to polarization, and remove incident propagation with a matched vacuum pulse on the same grid. Accumulate direct Ohmic and material-damping work separately from modified energy.

name.ja: 分散媒質の浅い入射角と長時間PML
name.en: Long-time grazing PML in a dispersive medium

caption.ja: 保存した浅角度の実電場を周期y方向へ再構成。灰色はPML領域です。 周期y方向の1周期を表示しています。波形を見やすくするため、x軸とy軸の表示縮尺は異なります。
caption.en: Actual saved grazing electric field reconstructed over the periodic y direction; gray shading marks the PML. One transverse y period is shown. The displayed x and y scales differ to make the fields visible.

note.ja: Yee・中点ADEに時刻配置を保った台形微分memoryを結合。正の物理散逸と符号付きPML数値仕事を区別し、補助場を含め全状態を保存します。
note.en: Couple Yee and midpoint ADE updates to a trapezoidal derivative-memory filter at native times. Separate positive physical dissipation from signed numerical PML work, retaining all physical and auxiliary states.

name.en: References and checks for this execution

note.ja: 12/18/24点/波長、32周期の過渡除去と8周期の計測。2本の閉曲線、前後4周期、同じ全時間を進めた半振幅phasorと5保存時刻の真空対照を検査し、円柱級数の散乱幅と外部場を照合します。
note.en: Use 12/18/24 points per wavelength, 32 burn-in periods and 8 measured periods. Check two contours, consecutive four-period windows, half-amplitude phasors after a complete repeated evolution, and a vacuum control at the five saved times. Compare scattering width and exterior fields with the cylindrical series.

name.ja: 誘電体円柱の外部級数と散乱幅
name.en: Exterior series and scattering width of a dielectric cylinder

note.ja: 解析解 無損失無限円柱、Ez偏光、c=ε0=μ0=1、半径0.25、ε=2.25、真空波長1。解析場は厳密な円の外部だけです。 Ezの無損失2D円柱のみで、3D球ではありません。階段状形状の誤差を記録し、一般の曲面2次精度や任意周波数・材料での精密散乱を保証しません。
note.en: Analytic reference Lossless infinite cylinder, Ez polarization, c = epsilon0 = mu0 = 1, radius 0.25, epsilon = 2.25 and vacuum wavelength 1. The analytical field is exterior to the exact circle. This is a lossless two-dimensional Ez cylinder, not a three-dimensional sphere. Report staircase geometry error without claiming general second-order curved-boundary accuracy or precision scattering for arbitrary frequencies and materials.

note.ja: s/p各3解像度の物質・真空12進行からω=5.1/6/6.9を測定。独立な有限窓の真空幾何級数、複素Fresnel係数、直接体積散逸、全stepのPEC収支と末尾を検査します。
note.en: Measure omega = 5.1/6/6.9 from 12 actual material/vacuum evolutions across three resolutions and both polarizations. Check an independent finite-window vacuum geometric sum, complex Fresnel coefficients, direct volume dissipation, all-step PEC budgets and final monitor tails.

name.ja: 斜め入射の複素Fresnel係数とLorentz板の直接散逸
name.en: Complex oblique Fresnel coefficients and direct Lorentz-slab loss

note.ja: 解析解 外側真空、ky=4、板[4,5]、ε∞=1.5、Δε=0.75、ω0=9、γ=0.5、σ=0.04。s=Ezとp=Hzをω=5.1/6/6.9で比較します。 任意の横方向分布ではなく単一kyの実空間制限です。1つの受動Lorentz極と有限帯域・有限窓のみ。Gaussian尾は厳密には非零で、窓診断と参照誤差を別記します。 全周波数で厳密にcap反射が未到達という証明ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz. This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

note.ja: 3つの格子・層強度の同時細分化、垂直・弱減衰対照の5長時間計算。参照入力が全て不変なことを確認して同一byteの無PML参照を再利用します。旧13検査本体を保持し、policy・peak12直接仕事の2回帰を追加。全44長時間判定は不変です。
note.en: Use five long trajectories: three joint grid/layer-strength resolutions, a normal control and a weakly damped companion. Reuse the byte-bound no-PML reference only after checking every unchanged reference argument. Retain the old 13 test bodies and add two parameter-policy/peak-12 work regressions; all original 44 long-trajectory gates remain unchanged.

name.ja: 浅角度分散波束の長時間・同格子孤立境界参照
name.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.
